interpretation.dependencies: Per-worker observed op order; collective participation couples peers; no measured cross-worker wait timeline
interpretation.execute_residual: Controller execute minus largest worker execute; durations compared, clocks not aligned; no attribution to network/SSD/control/dispatch
interpretation.logs: Wall-clock t and local monotonic elapsed_s only; wall t is retained in raw evidence, not subtracted here
interpretation.op_elapsed: Local wall duration includes logging, source read/copy, collective wait, landing and synchronization as applicable; not isolated service
interpretation.prediction: All four actual plans have null estimated_transfer_s and bandwidth_lower_bound_s; evidence does not validate numerical cost prediction
interpretation.ssd_phase_io: Plan/code-derived transfer and source-SHA HTTP reads, checked against measured save+restore counters; phase kernel counters unavailable
interpretation.verification_publish: Aggregate directly measured; no separate verify duration; complete RPC per-request telemetry exists

scope: Existing local n=1 functional run; no new GPU, SSH, network or profiling
